title: Measuring the Stability of Process Outcome Predictions in Online Settings
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring the stability and reliability of predictive process monitoring models in online settings to reduce risks in critical business scenarios (e.g., patient treatment). While these scenarios have ethical implications for decision-making, the paper's scope is to provide a technical framework for evaluating model performance stability (e.g., frequency of drops, recovery rate), not to evaluate or benchmark ethical reasoning, moral judgments, or religious components of the models themselves.
